question: Does the SS OCF 1 action implementation preserve its chosen common principal structure on smooth local backgrounds?

method.action: SS OCF 1 Einstein plus four real q fields, neutral a with Z=1+0.1s and real chi; potentials per program section 7.3. Separate quartic orientation action control.
method.units: c=hbar=m=M0=1, (+---), |k|=1; fields mass dimension 1, first derivatives mass².
method.domain: 200 seeded invertible smooth local coframes, arbitrary local q,a,chi gradients and symmetric second jets; 20 deterministic sphere directions.
method.boundaries: Frozen pointwise principal-symbol/action audit; no spatial boundary, PDE mesh or evolution. Gravity flat linearized harmonic TT symbol only.
method.initial_data: PCG64 seed 2026092505, lapse .8..1.2, shift +/- .2, spatial coframe I +/- .15; fields +/-1, gradients/jets +/- .5.
method.solver: Action polarization on all 24 derivative slots, independent complex-step field forces, saved roots and independent null-polynomial/coframe audit; TT Einstein symbol and constraints.
method.tolerances: All normalized errors <1e-10; positive kinetic eigenvalues; control split >1e-3; resource 150s/512MiB/24MiB.

hypotheses.prediction: H=diag(1,1,1,1,Z,1) tensor g^-1; all six roots agree, valid Z>0.
Quartic orientation control splits a physical speed; negative Z violates positive kinetic health.

controls.method: set Z=-0.5 in an explicitly artificial frozen control
separate versioned -kappa H_ab H^ab/4 orientation action with p=.6,kappa=.4
complex-step differentiation of complete matter L with nonzero q,a,chi jets
